description: Source code for Vulkan layer extensions management, including dynamic loading of layer libraries, enumeration of layers and extensions, and layer reference handling within the Vulkan API implementation.

classes.name: Layer
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan layer with properties, extensions, and library index.

classes.name: LayerLibrary
classes.description: Manages dynamic loading and enumeration of Vulkan layer libraries.

classes.name: LayerRef
classes.description: Reference-counted handle to a Vulkan layer, managing library load/unload.

methods.name: LayerLibrary::Open
methods.description: Loads the layer library dynamically, considering namespace restrictions.

methods.name: LayerLibrary::Close
methods.description: Unloads the layer library if no longer referenced.

methods.name: LayerLibrary::EnumerateLayers
methods.description: Enumerates available Vulkan layers and their extensions within the library.

methods.name: LayerLibrary::GetGPA
methods.description: Retrieves a function pointer from the layer library.

methods.name: DiscoverLayers
methods.description: Discovers available Vulkan layers from configured paths.

methods.name: GetLayerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of discovered layers.

methods.name: GetLayer
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific layer by index.

methods.name: GetLayerProperties
methods.description: Returns properties of a given layer.

methods.name: IsLayerGlobal
methods.description: Checks if a layer intercepts device commands globally.

methods.name: GetLayerInstanceExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves instance extensions supported by a layer.

methods.name: GetLayerDeviceExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves device extensions supported by a layer.

methods.name: FindLayerInstanceExtension
methods.description: Finds a specific instance extension by name.

methods.name: FindLayerDeviceExtension
methods.description: Finds a specific device extension by name.

methods.name: GetLayerRef
methods.description: Creates a reference to a layer, managing library load/unload.
